content: Projector error handling pattern (halt-on-exhaustion): projectors must process events in strict order — skipping ahead on error would leave gaps in the read model. Pattern: (1) on handle_event error, increment retry_count in GenServer state, (2) after max_retries exhausted, park the failed event to a dead-letter store (a dead_letter_events table with projector_name, event_position, event_data, error, occurred_at), (3) halt the projector GenServer via {:stop, :halted, state} — supervisor does NOT restart it automatically (use :temporary or explicit non-restart). (4) require manual intervention or admin action to either fix-and-resume or skip. Commanded implements this via error/3 returning {:stop, reason}. The supervisor child spec should be :restart => :transient so it doesn't auto-restart on halt.
